description: Where the coach stands on getting paid by their athletes, as the app's Get paid dialog shows it: whether their Stripe account is set up (none, incomplete, pending, ready), their offers, how much running monthly payments bring in per currency, how many asks are unpaid, and why a new payment cannot be asked for if it cannot. Athletes pay into the coach's own Stripe account and TriPeak takes nothing from it. Every TriPeak plan includes this, the trial too. start_payment_setup sets the account up.
name: get_payment_setup
